name: agentic-dev
description: You drive a loose loop, Frame, Explore, Build, Verify, Review, and a machine decides when it is done: a building skill that is the single entry for any change to code, a story or a chore: it takes the criteria and UAT you bring, plans, attacks the plan with a pre-mortem and a fresh review where it is risky, then builds test-first in its own worktree with tests that fail for the right reason; a prototyping skill that answers one question with throwaway code (a spike or proof of concept) with no tests or clean code, then deletes it; a reviewing skill that has a fresh agent review a finished change and a second prove or drop each finding, then fixes the blocking ones test-first within 3 rounds; a reflecting skill that has a fresh agent read the session of a finished change and tells you what to do next time; plus hooks for a done check that runs every test and the linter, an AGENTS.md size cap, a dependency gate, a pull request size cap, gates on commits that leave in debugging leftovers, switch a checker off, or change, remove or skip a test the branch started with, a gate on the first edit the building or prototyping skill did not frame, a gate on a pull request or merge no review preceded, and a reminder to run the reflecting skill once a branch is merged or opened as a pull request.
